method: Decimal OHLC from checksummed provider CSV; independent comparisons to pinned Parquet and public saved-replay summaries and selected receipts. The provider CSV and Parquet stayed local.

wick_close_witness.description: Provider price prefix as the wick-cross comparison control.

close_through_same_level.description: Set the final close to the same candle's crossing wick.

late_pivot_confirmation.description: Delay availability of the final EQH confirmation child by 20 seconds, preserving the OHLC.
